@common.attachEmailPlaceholder.sameAsSourceJustification: Example email address "you@example.com": a recognizable placeholder format, kept literal so the @-pattern still reads as an email hint. Apple/Microsoft zh keep example addresses in this Latin form.

@common.sizeUnit.megabyte.sameAsSourceJustification: macOS zh-CN Finder writes Latin unit symbols after a number (ProgressStatusView: 64.0 MB/1.33 GB), and the catalog already shows 1.02 MB in settings.listing.sizeUnit.description; KB and kB stay distinct as in English.
